frequency_question: What proportion of major proposed agency fee rules reach final publication in the Federal Register within the standard executive review window of under a year?
membership_rule: Includes any notice-and-comment proposed rule by a federal department establishing fee hikes classified as economically significant ($100M+ economic impact), excluding rules that are abandoned pre-publication or immediately enjoined indefinitely upon release.
window: 329 days from proposal to final rule publication

cases.name: Department of Labor H-2A/H-2B Wage Rule (2020)

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 named major fee rules; representative of high-priority agency revenue rulemaking tracks.
known_gaps: Does not fully capture outlier hyper-litigated emergency injunctions, though historical base rate for administrative completion of initiated fee rules remains extremely high once proposed.
skeleton: Not applicable; direct enumeration used for major fee rulemaking finalizations.
validity_reason: Valid through the current presidential administration's standard rulemaking lifecycle.
